{{Top|leg}}
An '''emergency stud''' was a structural device located aboard [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]]. When pressed, the emergency stud would trigger a series of small explosive bolts which jettisoned the canopy, allowing the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to make an emergency exit from the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]].
